sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 contains four exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings on Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. All elevations are labeled 'OPTION 01'. Scale varies: West and East at 1"=20'-0"; North and South at 1"=40'-0". Exact counts of dock doors, personnel doors, overhead coiling doors, storefront units, louvers, and LED wall packs require detailed counting from larger-scale prints - quantities shown as null due to resolution limitations. Project is NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Multiple finish tags reference 'COLOR LEGEND SEE ELEVATION' indicating colors are TBD. Glass schedule specifies three types (A, B, C) with identical U-values (.28) and SHGC (.25) but different fabrication/coating configurations.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 contains 13 miscellaneous architectural details at various scales (1/4"=1'-0", 3/4"=1'-0", 1/2"=1'-0", 1 1/2"=1'-0"). Details cover: ramp construction with guardrail (Details 12, 13, 4), typical bollard (Detail 7), stair construction (Details 6, 8, 10), Z-guard/track guard (Detail 9), fire riser/electrical panel bollard protection plan (Detail 11), pump/electrical room section (Detail 5), and future dock leveler details (Details 1, 2, 3). Quantities for guardrail LF, bollard count, stair treads, and CMU wall area must be taken from floor plans. Sheet marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Project: Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia.
